channel.title: Republic of Congo - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Republic of Congo, every source cited.

item.title: Rémy Ayayos Ikounga named deputy grand master of Congo's Masonic lodge
item.description: Colonel major Rémy Ayayos Ikounga replaces Jean-Dominique Okemba, who was removed in April.

item.title: CEMAC countries to withdraw old coins
item.description: Seven categories of old FCFA coins minted between 1958 and 1985 will lose legal tender status on November 1, 2026.

item.title: Congo football league expands to 18 clubs
item.description: The national championship will adopt a zonal format to manage costs for clubs.

item.title: UBA Congo clients must update accounts by December 2026
item.description: The bank requires updated personal and business client information to ensure security and regulatory compliance.
